mapper.sql: CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ABBR, CUSTOMER_TYPE, IS_ISSUER, IS_ASSTE_MANAGER, IS_TRUSTER, IS_SALER, IS_FINANCIER, IS_GUARANTEE, IS_RATING_AGENCIES, IS_PLEDGOR, IS_DEPOSIT_BANK, IS_INVEST_ADVISER, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CII USING (
SELECT '${item.customerName}' CUSTOMER_NAME, '${item.customerAbbr}' CUSTOMER_ABBR, '${item.customerType}' CUSTOMER_TYPE, '${item.isIssuer}' IS_ISSUER, '${item.isAssteManager}' IS_ASSTE_MANAGER, '${item.isTruster}' IS_TRUSTER, '${item.isSaler}' IS_SALER, '${item.isFinancier}' IS_FINANCIER, '${item.isGuarantee}' IS_GUARANTEE, '${item.isRatingAgencies}' IS_RATING_AGENCIES, '${item.isPledgor}' IS_PLEDGOR, '${item.isDepositBank}' IS_DEPOSIT_BANK, '${item.isInvestAdviser}' IS_INVEST_ADVISER, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME, '${item.customerId}' CUSTOMER_ID FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.CUSTOMER_ID = TEMP.CUSTOMER_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CUSTOMER_NAME = TEMP.CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ABBR = TEMP.CUSTOMER_ABBR, CUSTOMER_TYPE = TEMP.CUSTOMER_TYPE, IS_ISSUER = TEMP.IS_ISSUER, IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = TEMP.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER, IS_TRUSTER = TEMP.IS_TRUSTER, IS_SALER = TEMP.IS_SALER, IS_FINANCIER = TEMP.IS_FINANCIER, IS_GUARANTEE = TEMP.IS_GUARANTEE, IS_RATING_AGENCIES = TEMP.IS_RATING_AGENCIES, IS_PLEDGOR = TEMP.IS_PLEDGOR, IS_DEPOSIT_BANK = TEMP.IS_DEPOSIT_BANK, IS_INVEST_ADVISER = TEMP.IS_INVEST_ADVISER, CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ABBR, CUSTOMER_TYPE, IS_ISSUER, IS_ASSTE_MANAGER, IS_TRUSTER, IS_SALER, IS_FINANCIER, IS_GUARANTEE, IS_RATING_AGENCIES, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, IS_PLEDGOR, IS_DEPOSIT_BANK, IS_INVEST_ADVISER) values (TEMP.CUSTOMER_ID, TEMP.CUSTOMER_NAME, TEMP.CUSTOMER_ABBR, TEMP.CUSTOMER_TYPE, TEMP.IS_ISSUER, TEMP.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER, TEMP.IS_TRUSTER, TEMP.IS_SALER, TEMP.IS_FINANCIER, TEMP.IS_GUARANTEE, TEMP.IS_RATING_AGENCIES, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.IS_PLEDGOR, TEMP.IS_DEPOSIT_BANK, TEMP.IS_INVEST_ADVISER)
